nom: TULA Secret Solution Pro-Glycolic 10% Resurfacing Toner

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily T-zone skin report the toner reduces shine and oiliness by end of day without over-drying, and one notes it did not trigger her usual acne despite her oiliness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several with dry or dry-sensitive skin say it hydrates and does not dry out or crack their skin, while others (including one dry/very sensitive reviewer) report burning and irritation strong enough to want a refund.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances both oily and normal/dry areas, cleans pores, and improves smoothness without over-drying either zone.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most divided group: many say it is unusually gentle, non-stinging and calms breakouts, but a minority report immediate burning/irritation, especially near the eyes and nose.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s-50s report smoother texture, fewer visible fine lines/crow's feet and a brighter, more even tone with continued use.
segments.normal: One reviewer states the product suits every age and skin type and leaves skin soft and hydrated, without describing a specific normal-skin concern.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for anti-aging report visibly softer forehead wrinkles and less noticeable crow's feet after weeks of use; no dissent on this concern was found.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it hydrates, plumps and does not leave skin dry or flaky, but a few report the opposite: mild drying that required extra moisturizer, and in one case skin left cracky and burnt.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report it reduces redness and uneven tone over time and, unlike other acids, does not leave skin red or blotchy; however a couple of reviewers experienced immediate redness or a burning sensation right after application, sometimes fading, sometimes not.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe it as balancing and non-stripping when used correctly, with some diluting it or using fewer pumps to avoid over-exfoliating; one reviewer with dry/very sensitive skin got burns around the eyes and neck.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report faded dark spots, hyperpigmentation and sun damage patches evening out over weeks to months of consistent use; no reviewer disputes this specific outcome.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne or cystic breakouts report fewer new pimples, faster resolution of existing ones, and clearer skin over time; one reviewer states her breakouts got worse after about a week of use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report it controls end-of-day shine and keeps pores clearer without making skin oilier; no dissenting report on oiliness itself was found.

aspects.libelle: Initial tingling or burning on application
Small bottle empties fast with cotton pad use

extraits.texte: Not for dry or very senstive skin. It left me burnt around eyes near neck and its not a great purchase for me. Definitely fell for reviews. I wish i could return

Truly the cornerstone my whole routine is standing on. My husband and I joke about how if we don't use this, both of us are all but guaranteed a pimple and it's only funny because it's true. I have really sensitive-dry skin so I only use one pump and dilute it with a hydrating syrum to balance it out. He is combo-oily and even uses it to help the little bumps on his arms. We have been using it for two years and it is still a must-have for both of us.

I purchased this Tula Pro-Glycolic a few weeks ago to get the benefit of an AHA into my regular rotation, and since the 2nd ingredient is glycolic acid I felt this would be a great starter. I've been using retinA for the past 5 months for its anti-aging benefits and now that my skin is used to a full strength pharmaceutical retinoid I knew it was time to add an AHA specifically (glycolic) and I know Tula as a brand is pretty tolerable for sensitive skin, I really love this toner! I'm already noticing it working. It's not harsh and hasn't caused me to break out at all. I've used it like a serum and also like a regular toner, I feel like using it as a serum is my favorite way and it dries down perfectly too. To me it's not greasy, it's a lovely consistency. No pilling or any of that nonsense. I haven't had any trouble with the pump, I just hold the pump down and the product comes out as expected, either into my hand or on a reusable cotton round. I've used this at night as well as in the morning, but I feel like once a day is enough unless I'm feeling super dry. It's a nice combination with my other serum and my moisturizer before sunscreen in the morning. I'm really happy I decided to give this toner a try. There are cheaper alternatives but these ingredients are completely worth it. Especially since I'm super happy with the results so far, I'm actually surprised at how well it works, even using it once a day. I'm in my mid forties and have combination skin, if anyone is wonde
It works and does not sting my sensitive skin. It is making my complexion more even, better than the redness remover toner i bought. I am 54 with dry sensitive skin

I've been using this product for years as part of my routine and I can't live without it! I have very sensitive skin, acne and breaking out specifically, and Tula products have always agreed with me. I've never had a bad reaction!

This product worked for about a week. It brighten my skin and improved the texture but after about a week, my breakouts became worse. Read the label on the bottle because it says to wear sunscreen and limit sun exposure because it could cause a sunburn/make it worse. I'm not sure how good a product is for your skin if you're supposed to limit sun exposure, even a week after you're done using it.

I love this toner. It is one of the best ones I have ever tried without a doubt. My skin. I have combination skin with an oily T-zone area. I also get heavy cystic acne in my beard and hair follicles. This toner makes my skin feel so clean and well-toned after a good face cleaning. It has definitely almost eliminated my breakout issues. If I do still get a breakout, this toner has the top skin layer peeling by the next day and growing in new skin!!!! I only have two issues with this toner. 1) Sometimes the pump comes defective. I've noticed when I get one with a pump issue, I usually have to hold it upside down to get the toner to flow. That or twist off the top (Yes, it does twist off!). 2) The size. I wish they made this in a bigger size than the 3 Oz bottle. But oh well. Note- Since as a guy I have a beard, I don't follow the instructions on the bottle. It says to pump it onto a cotton pad and swab your face. However, the cotton just gets stuck in my facial hair. Instead, I just pump it directly onto my fingertips and rub it in. Works great!
